Team —

We have our QBR slot next week (Mon 11/09). I want a concise operational clearance slide that summarizes launch-readiness across GTM, enablement, pricing, docs, and support. I attached a one-pager starter (QBR_one_pager.pdf) — please use that as the baseline.

Ask: can each of you reply in-thread with a short status (GREEN/AMBER/RED), top 2 risks, and the single slide bullet you want me to call out in the QBR? Keep it 1–2 lines.

Quick framing from me: we are broadly ready but there are three lingering frictions that leadership will want clarity on — support playbook completion, final pricing tier approval, and a narrow docs acceptance gap for partner onboarding. We should present mitigations and owners.

Attachments: QBR_one_pager.pdf (stub)

Thanks —
Sofia

- Overall status: AMBER (operational frictions mitigated with owners and deadline commitments).
- Key mitigations to highlight: Enablement labs shipping 11/10 (Laura), Pricing legal sign-off targeted 11/08 (Marcus), Support playbook final 11/09 and pilot 11/10 (Kimberly + Acme).
- Ask for slide owners: Laura (enablement slide), Marcus (pricing economics + appendix), Kimberly (support runbook + pilot plan). I will take the operations summary and the single-page risk heatmap.

Action items (owners/deadlines):
- Marcus: escalate SLA redline to Legal today; confirm in-thread when done (deadline 11/08 EOD).
- Kimberly: publish final playbook link and incident table by 11/09 5pm PT.
- Laura: circulate the lab rehearsal notes after 11/06 and add a 1-slide summary for QBR by 11/08.
- Aditya: can you surface any outstanding field enablement budget asks for the QBR (cc'd) by 11/07?

I'll consolidate slides into the one-pager and circulate a final slide-deck draft by Sunday 11/08 AM for review. If anyone sees a change to their status (GREEN->RED or similar), update the thread immediately.

Sofia
